notes.title: MAGEYE's Future + Development Update
notes.content:
Hello sightseers,
Due to some smelly circumstances, I am becoming rather uncertain for this game's future. If you have not been mindlessly wandering through life as though in a haze you may have noticed a large amount of er... silencing occurring throughout the internet.

In relation to this, I have not been revealing the full contents of this game for specific reasons and perhaps it is a good thing this game has yet to garner any sort of major attention prior to its release.

The game's content is highly controversial, and I am bound to receive a few death threats for sure - I could not care less if I do. I am not going to quit development on the game due to previously stated causes, if anything this is encouraging me to create this even more.

Whether the game is taken down or not, I do not think I could say I give much of a fuck. You're all suffering with me. I'll continue working on this no matter the cost.


Also... if you want to know how close the game is to being finished:
I currently need to make 9 more levels, add some more NPCs, maybe add a few extras and do some other monotonous dev stuff, then the game will hopefully be ready for release!

notes.title: A Big Thanks + Q&A
notes.content:
Hello sightseers,


I would like to thank everyone who shared the game, played the demo, wishlisted it, or checked it out during Next Fest. I wasn't expecting to even get 100 wishlists, but we ended up with 200 wishlists! So yeah, I guess I am pretty satisfied with everything, especially considering how rough the demo was and how weird and niche this whole thingamajig is.


To celebrate, I am doing a Q&A where I'll be able to answer any questions from any curious two leggeds:Q&A Discussion Thread

Other stuffs:
Next Fest aside, here's a little update on the game itself.

Originally, this project was going to be much smaller. My initial plan was to release something short, just to see if people would enjoy what I have stored for the future. But I've since expanded the game, improved the story, and currently I have around 25 levels planned for the final game, and it will likely be two hours long.

The final game will be more polished, but it will still retain a very minimalist feel. So don't expect some hyper-polished triple-A production, just know it'll feel better without losing any of its raw emotion.

Expect more two legged enemies, and a lot more trauma and grief in store, as this gets far darker than the demo. ;)

The game will likely be priced at around $5. I'm doing my utmost to make this game something special, so that hopefully, when this thing is out, I am not being doxed and having rocks thrown at my window by people demanding their money back after release day. I hope people are satisfied with this when it is out.



Nothing else to say other than smell you later.

(HAHAHA! FUNNY JOKE)

notes.title: MAGEYE Demo Update 1
notes.content:
Hello, fellow sightseers!

I've made an update that adds a few a tweaks, some bug fixes, and an options menu that is now available when paused, which includes a much needed volume control. I send my deepest condolences to anyone who had their ears blasted off during your nefarious eye stealing.

As for the future, I have plans to add the option for other languages, and to release the game on Linux at some point. I am however currently prioritising completing the game right now, so don't expect this anytime soon until after the game is released. As for a release date, hell even I don't know when it'll be out. It's too early to say.

I would like to thank anyone that has played my demo, wishlisted the game, or just noticed my game in some form (even if it is severely fucked in places). Your choice to meddle within my monstrosities is equally flattering as well as disturbing.

Anyway... I need to get back work. Stay safe, and happy eye hunting!
